note: NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP is the canonical host for the configured chlorophyll and ETOPO datasets. NOAA-20 daily chlorophyll latitude is a descending coordinate axis and must be requested north-to-south. ETOPO 15-arc-second data is sampled at stride 15 across the broad North America grid to keep requests bounded; this is regional context, not reef-scale bathymetry. The gap-filled chlorophyll product is disabled until its freshness and scientific suitability are independently validated; do not enable it merely because the primary source is unavailable.

freshness.basis: Provisional operational thresholds for a daily gridded SST product; validate against observed ERDDAP latency.

chlorophyll.note: Near-real-time NOAA-20 VIIRS, 4 km. Daily scenes have gaps under cloud; see valid_fraction in the output.

freshness.basis: Provisional operational thresholds for daily satellite scenes; cloud gaps and processing latency are expected.

chlorophyll_gapfilled.note: Cloud gaps are filled by a statistical method (DINEOF), so filled cells are estimates. Use as a fallback and label confidence lower. Dimensions and variable name unverified.

bathymetry.note: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022 15-arc-second global relief model. Sampled every 15 source cells (~3.75 arc-minutes) to bound the broad North America request; do not interpret this as reef-scale or shallow-flat bathymetry. Negative z values are below sea level, so depth_m = -z.

currents.note: NOAA CoastWatch geostrophic currents from satellite altimetry, daily, 25 km grid, listed as experimental. u = east, v = north, in m/s. Dimensions and variable names are from the ERDDAP listing and not yet verified here: run check_sources.

freshness.basis: Provisional operational thresholds for a daily satellite-altimetry product; validate against observed ERDDAP latency.

arcgis.note: Both reef sources must load or yellowtail is reported as waiting for data. Artificial reefs: FWC layer 12 (checked in the browser inspector). Natural reef: FWC Unified Reef Map v2.2 (Jan 2025), layer 16, filtered on ClassLv1 to reef and hard bottom only.

natural_reef.where: ClassLv1 IN ('Individual or Aggregated Patch Reef','Aggregate Reef','Ridge','Pavement')

unified_benthic.source_label: FWC Unified Reef Map v2.2, Level 0 (released January 2025; component source dates vary)

closures.note: No-fishing areas from NOAA's National MPA Center MPA Inventory (2023 edition, service data last edited Jan 2025). Only areas whose Fishing Restrictions text says recreational fishing is prohibited are used. Fishery management areas, security zones and seasonal closures are not in this inventory.
closures.source_label: NOAA National MPA Center, MPA Inventory (2023 edition)
